martha.name: Martha
martha.comment: Martha, not great for running today with the heat, but perfect swimming weather from 17:00–19:00, with temps around 27°C and comfortable humidity. Surprise Britt with a swim when they get home, you've both earned it after a long day.

britt.name: Britt
britt.comment: Britt, it's a swimming kind of day, surprisingly - great conditions from 17:00 to 19:00, with temps around 25-28°C. Not ideal for cycling, too hot, but perfect for a relaxed swim. If Martha's free, surprise her with a swim and a cold drink on the terrace after.
